history.reason: First goldens. Against core 18b2a53e6 the structured EINet, indexed, point-MLP, additive population and affine-MLP cases are bitwise identical; population_network_shunting and unified_rnn_dendritic_shunting change only at d3c2c233c (excitation-only shunting compartments couple to their children at the midpoint voltage instead of 1e-6), found by bisecting every branch commit.

Sixteen cases added: EINets with [4], [3,3] and reduced-density trees, a two-layer E-I EINet, every sparse-synapse family (stochastic, variance, dense_to_sparse, deepst, indexed_rewire, indexed_release, indexed_dynamic), a population network at reduced density, a recurrent rate-mode population (level taus, mechanism-neutral initialization), the spatial conv and tensor-map cores and the typed DendriNetConfig path. Against core 18b2a53e6, ten are bitwise identical; population_network_branched_reduced_density, spatial_dendritic_conv and tensor_map change only at d3c2c233c (midpoint coupling, as for the first goldens); einet_two_layer_inhibitory and einet_sparsity_deepst build their declared inhibitory cells from 1af5ef337 (input_mode retired; 18b2a53e6 silently built none and 3f40249bd rejected the config), found by bisecting the branch's first-parent commits.
